newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Treasury 5-yr notes seen yielding 6.04/05 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Treasury 5-yr notes seen yielding 6.04/05 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $11.5 billion in five-year notes on Wednesday is expected to produce a yield betwen 6.04 and 6.05 percent, dealers said.
They said demand for the issue was expected to be decent.

At around 1240 EDT/1640, the five-year notes were trading with a when-issued yield of 6.045 percent. The bidding deadline is set for 1300 EDT/1700 GMT. Results for the auction are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
